arxiv-1612-09439.title: Hodge Numbers from Picard–Fuchs Equations This paper is a contribution to the Special Issue on Modular Forms and String Theory in honor of Noriko Yui. The full collection is available at http://www.emis.de/journals/SIGMA/modular-forms.html
arxiv-1612-09439.creator: Charles F. DORAN † 1 {}^{{\dagger}^{1}}, Andrew HARDER † 2 {}^{{\dagger}^{2}} and Alan THOMPSON † 3 † 4 {}^{{\dagger}^{3}{\dagger}^{4}}
arxiv-1612-09439.description: Abstract Given a variation of Hodge structure over ℙ 1 \mathbb{P}^{1} with Hodge numbers ( 1 , 1 , … , 1 ) (1,1,\dots,1) , we show how to compute the degrees of the Deligne extension of its Hodge bundles, following Eskin–Kontsevich–Möller–Zorich, by using the local exponents of the corresponding Picard–Fuchs equation.

arxiv-2107-05336.title: Nonlinear Dendritic Coincidence Detection for Supervised Learning
arxiv-2107-05336.creator: Fabian Schubert, Claudius Gros
arxiv-2107-05336.description: Abstract Cortical pyramidal neurons have a complex dendritic anatomy, whose function is an active research field. In particular, the segregation between its soma and the apical dendritic tree is believed to play an active role in processing feed-forward sensory information and top-down or feedback signals.

arxiv-2201-03380.title: Bounded Space Differentially Private Quantiles
arxiv-2201-03380.creator: Daniel Alabi, Omri Ben-Eliezer, Anamay Chaturvedi
arxiv-2201-03380.description: Abstract . Estimating the quantiles of a large dataset is a fundamental problem in both the streaming algorithms literature and the differential privacy literature. However, all existing private mechanisms for distribution-independent quantile computation require space at least linear in the input size n n .

arxiv-2511-01629.title: Constraint Penalization Method in the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) for Fluid–Structure Interaction
arxiv-2511-01629.creator: Tristan Millet, Erwan Liberge
arxiv-2511-01629.description: Abstract A constraint penalization method is introduced within the Lattice Boltzmann (LBM) framework to model fluid–structure interactions involving rigid bodies. The proposed approach extends the fictitious domain concept by enforcing the rigid-body motion through a penalization term directly applied to the fluid velocity field, eliminating the need for explicit Lagrange multipliers or interface force computation.

pmc-10737565.title: MOTIVATIONS AND ROLE CAPTIVITY AMONG INFORMAL CAREGIVERS TO COMMUNITY-DWELLING PERSONS WITH DEMENTIA
pmc-10737565.creator: Rachel Bloom, Francesco Osso, Megan McCarthy, Francesca Falzarano
pmc-10737565.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). There are 11 million informal (unpaid) caregivers currently assisting a person with dementia in the United States. Motivations for taking on this challenging role vary, with many citing their responsibility to family or a shared interpersonal history. Many caregivers do not feel as if they have a choice in taking on care responsibilities for relational and/or financial reasons and are held “captive” in this role.

pmc-11370028.title: Global forecasting of chronic kidney disease mortality rates and numbers with the generalized additive model
pmc-11370028.creator: Fatemeh Shahbazi, Amin Doosti-Irani, Alireza Soltanian, Jalal Poorolajal
pmc-11370028.description: BackgroundChronic kidney disease (CKD) is an important public health problem worldwide; therefore, forecasting CKD mortality rates and death numbers globally is vital for planning CKD prevention programs. This study aimed to characterize the temporal trends in CKD mortality at the international level from 1990 to 2019 and predict CKD mortality rates and numbers until 2030.

pmc-13040091.creator: Najeebuddin Mohammed, Ashima Sharma, Alekhya Machani, Sujata Patnaik
pmc-13040091.description: Although uncommon, laryngotracheal injuries carry a significant risk of mortality. Central Message

Cardiac surgery in inherited von Willebrand disease requires individualized perioperative hemostatic management guided by factor replacement and real-time coagulation monitoring. Perspective

Current evidence on cardiac surgery in von Willebrand disease is limited and heterogeneous.
